_meta.purpose: Alternative _output.example content sets for the 8 hub prompts. The original moors-themed examples leaked their CONTENT into small-model output (gemma3:4b copied 'Copperlash Rider', 'Dangerous Copper Moors', 'Apprentice Moors Reaver' verbatim in 3/8 hubs) and could collide with real registry ids. Both sets below keep the exact same XML SHAPE and per-tool constraint keys; only the illustrative content differs. Apply with: python tools/hub_example_set_apply.py --set <name>. Test with: python tools/hub_cert_harness.py --model gemma3:4b.

sets.frostpeak: A coherent off-theme mini-saga (glacial highlands). If a model leaks example content into a normal firing, the frost-themed name is visibly out of place AND cannot collide with live moors/forest content.
sets.schematic: Deliberately placeholder-flavored neutral content (Example Ore, Sample Creature). If a model leaks it, the output is glaringly artificial and trivially caught by the supervisor or a human eye.
sets.moors_original: The original hand-authored moors saga examples (pre-2026-07-11). Kept for reference/rollback. Known issue: content leaks into moors-themed firings on small models.
